testcase.name: once the read is complete an empty row is a real answer
a fresh guide has nothing to say about its age
a failure with programmes on screen is a data error
a cache emission is not yet a complete read
a channel the read never asked for stays a skeleton
cached programmes are content even before the server answers
a cache answer with nothing yet is a load, never an empty guide
a completed read with programmes is content
a guide that was never dated has nothing to say about its age
a network emission completes the read
before anything is read nothing is announced
a cache emission with a reason is a failed read
a failed import is said as incomplete, without inventing a date
a cache row with nothing yet stays a skeleton
a source with no guide configured is not a failure and not empty
a stale guide dates itself from the last import
a row with cached programmes is answered before the server speaks
a completed read with nothing over the day is empty
an initial failure with no data is an initial error, not an empty guide
